clips.title: The story
paras: Gnoll Paws reach Sentinel Hill as proof of a patrol against Westfall’s Riverpaw packs. The People's Militia offers bounties to help protect local farmsteads.

The People's Militia defends Westfall from Sentinel Hill. With the royal army absent and the crown seemingly blind to rural troubles, ordinary citizens and volunteers face outlaws, rogue mechanoids, and Riverpaw gnolls. Captain Danuvin offers bounties for proof that gnolls have been slain. Bringing back their paws shows that patrols have searched the scrublands instead of resting beneath the watchtower.
